name: Read-only wildcard admin (Get*/List*/Describe* on *) - broad, but NOT privileged escalation / critical
note: The ReadOnlyAccess shape: enumeration across services on all resources. Broad visibility is not the same as the power to change state or cross a privilege boundary.
rationale: Get*/List*/Describe* are read-only actions: they enumerate metadata and configuration but do not modify state, create credentials, or pass/assume roles. iam:Get*/iam:List* is IAM READ, not IAM administration, so DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN is a false positive here. None of these actions read object DATA payloads (s3:List* lists keys, not object bodies), so DATA-EXFIL should not fire. There is no privilege-boundary crossing, hence no escalation and nothing critical. Broad enumeration on * is legitimately a broad-resource observation (WILDCARD-RESOURCE / WILDCARD-ACTION at most high). Ref: AWS managed policy 'ReadOnlyAccess' semantics; read actions are not privilege escalation.
